reason: I would not move my money through a company I just saw once, even with the guarantee. My community CA already handles my taxes and could probably do the 15CA/15CB for less, and I compare every paisa so I want to see the real exchange rate before I decide.
objection: What if the transfer gets stuck halfway or the CA rejects something? The guarantee only refunds their fee, not the days my money is sitting in limbo, and I do not know this company.
would_change_my_mind: A real sample receipt showing the exact rate against Wise and my bank, a way to check the FINTRAC registration and partner bank myself, and a fee around $99 for ₹10 lakh.
